description: Finds parking near where the driver is going: place is a U.S. address, venue, landmark or city ("Coors Field, Denver"), or send lat and lng. Nearest first, with spaces left and the current price. vehicle narrows the list to lots that take a car, truck, tractor-trailer or RV, with truck rates where a lot sets them. No API key needed. Results include bookable Park Graph lots (lots; each id is the lot_id that get_lot, the quote tool and reserve take) plus public directory lots (unlisted_lots, with a page_url; not bookable). The top-level summary is a one-line, plain-language answer. An empty lots list means no bookable Park Graph lot near there. Every payment completes on parkgraph.com with the driver present; no tool charges money on its own.

lat.description: Latitude of the driver's destination, sent with lng

lng.description: Longitude of the driver's destination, sent with lat

place.description: Where the driver is going: a U.S. address, venue, landmark or city ("Coors Field, Denver", "JFK Terminal 4"). Sent in place of lat and lng.

radius_km.description: Search radius around that point, in km

vehicle.description: Only lots that take this vehicle. truck covers box trucks, trailers and tractor-trailers; rv means lots with oversized spaces.

name: search_lots
title: Search parking lots
